spans.s:
अस्फुट अ-स्फुट, अम्, n. indistinct speech;
(अस्, आ, अम्), indistinct, obscure, invisible, unblown.
—अस्फुट-फल, अम्, n. indistinct result; (in
geom.) gross area of a triangle, &c.
—अ-स्फुट-
वाच्, क्, क्, क्, lisping, speaking indistinctly.

आस्फल् आ-स्फल् or आ-स्फुल्, Caus. -स्फाल-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to flap, rock or shake.

आ-स्फाल, अस्, m. striking, rubbing, causing to
move gently; flapping, clapping; the flapping mo-
tion of an elephant's ear.

आ-स्फालन, अम्, n. rubbing, stirring, flapping,
moving gently; striking; pride, arrogance.

आ-स्फालित, अस्, आ, अम्, struck gently, rubbed,
touched, stirred; flapped, clapped, struck together.

आस्फाय् आ-स्फाय्, cl. 1. A. -स्फायते, -यि-
तुम्, to grow, increase.

आस्फुजित् आस्फुजित् = Ἀφροδίτη N. of the
planet Venus.

आस्फोट आ-स्फोट, अस्, m. (rt. स्फुट्), moving
or flapping to and fro, quivering, trembling, shaking,
the sound of clapping or striking on the arms as
made by combatants, wrestlers, &c.; a plant, see
आ-स्फोत; (आ), f. a wild variety of Jasmin.
आ-स्फोटक, अस्, m., the plant Careya Arborea.

आ-स्फोटन, अम्, n. moving to and fro, flapping,
trembling; shaking; blowing, expanding; contracting,
closing, sealing; slapping or clapping the arms, or
the noise made by it; (ई), f. a gimlet or auger.

आ-स्फोत or आ-स्फोतक, अस्, m. (probably an in-
correct form of आ-स्फोट), N. of several plants, Ca-
lotropis Gigantea, Bahinia Variegata L., Echites Di-
chotoma Roxb.; (आ), f., N. of several plants, Jasmi-
num Sambac, Clitoria Terneata, Echites Frutescens
or Echites Dichotoma.
